payload.title: Sony shuts down Dark Outlaw Games, former CoD developer's studio, amid wider PlayStation cuts
payload.content: Sony has shut down Dark Outlaw Games, the studio founded by former Call of Duty developer Jason Blundell, amid broader cuts to PlayStation overall. Around 50 people are losing their jobs across PlayStation, including on the mobile teams. Blundell's previous studio Deviation was also partnered with Sony and closed in 2024. Sony confirmed the changes, stating they were made 'to support long-term sustainability.'
